claims: Jessie Buckley won the Best Actress award at the 2026 Oscars.
The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars were held on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley won the Best Actress award for her role as Agnes Shakespeare in Hamnet.
Rose Byrne was a Best Actress nominee at the 2026 Oscars for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You.
Kate Hudson was a Best Actress nominee at the 2026 Oscars for Song Sung Blue.
Renate Reinsve was a Best Actress nominee at the 2026 Oscars for Sentimental Value.
Emma Stone was a Best Actress nominee at the 2026 Oscars for Bugonia.
Jessie Buckley is the first Irish winner of the Best Actress Oscar, according to The Guardian.
